items.title: More autonomy, fewer NDAs: Volunteers have new requests for brain implant trials
items.raw_text: Scientists have been working on ways to decode brain activity for decades. Teams have developed brain implants that can be used to control robotic limbs and computers, and even to “speak.” The people who volunteer for trials of those devices play a vital role in that research, and they ought to be recognized for their contributions, says Ian Burkhart , who had one implanted in his own brain back in 2014. He’s been working on a set of guidelines for researchers developing brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Ethics guidelines for clinical trials already exist. But BCI trials are different, says Jennifer Chandler, a professor of law and neuroethics at the University of Ottawa who also worked on the guidelines. “These are people who have a device embedded in their brain, are in trials sometimes for years and years … [and contribute] a significant investment of time, of the body, and of intellectual effort.” Burkhart was left paralyzed from the chest down following a diving accident in 2010, when he was 19 years old. Around four years later, he volunteered to become the first person to trial a brain implant designed for hand control. He had an array of 96 electrodes inserted into the part of his brain that controls movement. The electrodes were connected to a computer via a cable that essentially plugged into his head. items.title: Silicon Valley claims to know the future. So why did it get the midterms so wrong?
items.raw_text: The self-styled visionaries of Silicon Valley, leaders like OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman and SpaceX boss Elon Musk, have built careers claiming to see the future. Long-term vision is currency: Meta’s Mark Zuckerberg built a 10-year road map for Facebook in 2016, and Google famously told investors before its public offering that it was unconcerned with short-term results. And yet there they all were, a mere five weeks before the midterm elections, gathered at the White House to smile for photos with President Trump and sign on to his “Super Intelligence” agenda. Even by the diminished standards of today’s corporate governance, this was a shockingly foolish decision. Despite dozens of polls showing a rising tide of anti-Trump sentiment and bipartisan rejection of AI and data centers , the futurists of the tech elite cast aside long-term corporate interests for short-term political favor. And now, their industry is very squarely in the new victors’ crosshairs . For an industry obsessed with pattern recognition, their decision to lash themselves to President Trump has proved to be a catastrophic misreading of the political landscape. Now, not only have they jeopardized their companies’ fates, but they’ve also raised questions about their vision and judgment. What were they thinking? items.title: Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility
items.raw_text: Representatives from Nvidia told Illinois representative Bill Foster that it would be technically possible to implement the anti-smuggling measures called for in the Chip Security Act, Foster told MIT Technology Review in an interview on Thursday, even while an industry group claimed they were “potentially infeasible.” Foster, a Democrat who serves on the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, is a cosponsor of the act, which would introduce geotracking requirements to verify the location of advanced AI chips in order to prevent their smuggling to China. It is one of three chip-security bills under consideration for inclusion in the Senate’s National Defense Authorization Act, each of which is drawing renewed attention after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation and reported affair with an alleged Chinese spy. When the Chip Security Act was introduced, in May 2025, lawmakers said the technology to implement it existed, something Nvidia has not publicly confirmed. In March 2026, the Semiconductor Industry Association, of which Nvidia is a member, explicitly opposed the bill and wrote that its mandates for chip tracking were “new, untested, and potentially infeasible.” But privately, Nvidia representatives working with Foster told the lawmaker that the company could implement them. “They never put anything in writing,” Foster says, but during technical discussions on the possibility of such safeguards, their reaction was “yeah, of course we can do this.” This private ackn

items.title: Specialized’s Tarmac SL9 S-Level is built to wreck your Zone 2 ride
items.raw_text: I love a good Zone 2 ride . There’s nothing like getting on the bike, settling into a groove, and letting the miles (and hours) flow by. But sometimes when I hopped on the Specialized Tarmac SL9 S-Level, Zone 2 would turn into a tempo ride. It was like having a little imp—the stereotype dressed in red with the pitchfork—on my left shoulder whispering into my ear: “Go fast. This bike was built to go fast. Speed is good. You can do a Zone 2 ride tomorrow.” Normally, I'd count on the good imp—the dude with the harp and wings—on my right shoulder to restrain these urges. But the Tarmac is so seductive that he would just shrug and say “he’s got a point.” And in a moment of weakness, I would drop the hammer and head into the red, just because the SL9 makes that so rewarding. The Tarmac SL9 is Specialized’s aero road bike, with the S-Level sitting just below the S-Works in Specialized’s top tier of carbon, aero road bikes, where it replaced the Tarmac SL8 Pro. After it got an update this year, I spent several weeks riding it, putting nearly 1,000 miles on it Specialized offers the Tarmac SL9 in four models, all available with SRAM and Shimano drivetrains (Ars tested the SRAM version). Notably, you don't need to buy the top-of-the-line bike to get the top-of-the-line groupset. items.title: Opgestapte Nvidia-topman moet getuigen voor Senaat om affaires
items.raw_text: Jensen Huang, voormalig topman van chipgigant Nvidia, is opgeroepen om te getuigen voor een Amerikaanse Senaatscommissie. Huang stapte gisteren op na een nieuwe onthulling over een buitenechtelijke relatie. The New York Times schreef dat Huang een affaire had gehad met een directe medewerker binnen Nvidia. Persbureau Reuters berichtte daarna op basis van twee ingewijden dat er sprake was van een derde affaire, wederom met een werknemer van Nvidia. Vorige week werd Huangs eerste affaire bekend, die hij ook toegaf. Hierbij ging het volgens diverse media om zijn naamgenoot Alice Huang, die ervan wordt verdacht voor China te spioneren. Over de verhoudingen tussen deze Chinese zakenvrouw en de Chinese overheid lijkt binnen de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten twijfel te bestaan. Vorige week meldden bronnen bij de diensten tegen Amerikaanse media dat er bewijs is dat ze als spion werkte. Andere bronnen spreken dat nu tegen CNN tegen. Volgens CNN doet de FBI al minstens een jaar onderzoek naar de affaire met de vermeende spion. Zij is de voormalige leidinggevende van het Singaporese bedrijf Megaspeed, een belangrijke afnemer van Nvidia-chips. Senaatscommissie Oud-CEO Huang is opgeroepen om zich te verantwoorden tegenover de Senaatscommissie voor Bankzaken. Een van de senatoren, de Republikein Tim Scott, heeft Huang verzocht om zich op 3 december vrijwillig te melden. Als dat niet gebeurt kan hij worden gedagvaard. Dan moet hij verplicht getuigen. items.title: Wereldwijde storing treft Microsoft, miljoenen gebruikers de dupe
items.raw_text: Microsoft 365 kampt sinds gistermiddag 17.15 uur Nederlandse tijd met een wereldwijde storing. Verschillende diensten, waaronder Outlook en Microsoft Teams, zijn hierdoor moeilijk bereikbaar of werken helemaal niet. Gebruikers hebben problemen met hun e-mail en kunnen niet online vergaderen. Ook AI-functies van Copilot werken niet. Volgens Microsoft komt de storing door een "verhoogde belasting" van de infrastructuur. Op X schrijft Microsoft dat dit komt doordat "een aantal servers onverwacht niet beschikbaar is, waardoor de resterende infrastructuur onder druk komt te staan". Van een cyberaanval is volgens het techbedrijf geen sprake. Wat dan wel de oorzaak van de storing is, maakt het bedrijf naar eigen zeggen pas bekend zodra het probleem is verholpen. De storing is voor zover bekend merkbaar in ruim zeventig landen. Herstart nog niet gelukt Microsoft zegt "met man en macht" te werken aan een oplossing. Zo wordt geprobeerd de getroffen systemen te herstarten. Vannacht meldde het bedrijf dat pogingen hiertoe nog niet het gewenste effect hadden. In de vroege ochtend meldde het techbedrijf dat diensten deels weer zouden moeten werken. Rond 08.45 uur sprak Microsoft van "positieve resultaten en verhoogde capaciteit", maar er is nog altijd geen stabiele oplossing. Wereldwijd zijn er meer dan 430 miljoen gebruikers van Microsoft 365, een abonnement waarin Office-apps als Word, Excel en Powerpoint zitten. items.title: Sggswerk
items.raw_text: Deze week bespreken we ons actieonderzoek naar sekswerk met Eva de Goeij. Evelyn deelt haar overweging om terug te keren op TikTok. Terug op TikTok? Evelyn overweegt weer TikTok te nemen, omdat ze een deel van de online cultuur mist. Als voorbeeld noemt ze een saga van een sociale-media boyband , Boy Throb,waarvan 3 leven in de VS en een in India woont. Via het aanvragen van een werkvisum, en allerlei juridische procedures probeerden ze het vierde lid naar Amerika te krijgen. Evelyn mist het om dit soort verhalen in real time mee te krijgen, maar tegelijkertijd vindt ze ook het algoritme van TikTok erg problematisch. Sggswerk In ons onderzoek naar sekswerk kijken we samen met sekswerkers en belangenorganisaties naar de problemen waar zij tegen aan lopen in het digitale domein. Sekswerk is de uitwisseling van seksuele diensten tussen instemmende volwassenen tegen een beloning, meestal geld. Het is in Nederland een legaal beroep. De sector is divers: je kan denken aan escorts, raamprostitutie, strippers, thuisontvangst en online content creators op bijvoorbeeld OnlyFans. ‘Er is een schatting dat zo’n 30.000 mensen sekswerk doen. items.title: FBI: Noord-Korea gebruikte deepfakes om honderden miljoenen aan crypto te stelen
items.raw_text: Noord-Koreaanse hackers hebben volgens de FBI met slinkse deepfakevideo's in anderhalf jaar tijd zo'n 400 miljoen dollar in crypto buit weten te maken, meer dan 350 miljoen euro. De Amerikaanse politiedienst vond meer dan 900 deepfakevideo's van slachtoffers, die gebruikt werden om nieuwe mensen te duperen. De hackers deden zich voor als een bekende van hun slachtoffers. Ze benaderden die met een boodschap om met een videobelletje weer eens bij te kletsen of een samenwerking te bespreken. Slachtoffers hadden niet door dat de videobeelden van deze persoon waren gemaakt met AI. Het videogesprek verliep ook niet via bekende apps als Zoom, Teams of Meets, maar via niet van echt te onderscheiden kopieën daarvan, die draaien op Noord-Koreaanse servers. Slachtoffers kregen tijdens de gesprekken een bericht dat er iets mis was met hun verbinding, wat ze zogenaamd konden verhelpen via een link die werd meegestuurd. Maandenlang geduld Wie op de link klikte, werd digitaal overgeleverd aan de hackers. Die kregen toegang tot cryptoaccounts, mailgegevens en chatberichten. Ook werden opnames via de webcam gemaakt, om bekenden van het slachtoffer te benaderen met diens gezicht. Omdat de hackers ook communicatie in handen hadden, konden ze zich in berichten makkelijk voordoen als het slachtoffer, zeker als ze ook diens accounts op LinkedIn, Telegram, Slack of Discord hadden overgenomen. In reversal, American Cancer Society urges routine prostate cancer screening
items.raw_text: In a significant update to its guidelines for prostate cancer screening, the American Cancer Society is now recommending that men get routinely screened for prostate cancer with a PSA test. Men at average risk should get a PSA test every two years from age 50 to 69, according to the new guidelines released Thursday. Men considered at high risk due to race and family history should start testing earlier, at 45, and most are recommended to get tested every year. Specifically, yearly testing starting at age 45 is recommended for all Black men, who have higher rates of prostate cancer. Non-Black men should also get yearly testing starting at 45 if a close relative was diagnosed with prostate cancer before age 65, or if more than one of their relatives has had prostate cancer. On the other hand, if only one close relative was diagnosed with prostate cancer and it was diagnosed at age 65 or older, non-Black men in this case should start PSA screening at 45, but are recommended to get testing only every two years. items.raw_text: The US government has expanded the use of an AI tool for advising air traffic controllers to assist in managing air traffic across the entire national airspace system. Airline executives have voiced support for the rollout, but the US labor union representing air traffic controllers has said it was not involved in designing or testing the AI-driven system. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) says the $875 million SMART system has helped reroute 180 flights since being implemented in airspace over Washington, DC, on September 21. The agency claims that this saved an average of 10 minutes per flight and almost 80 gallons of fuel per flight—and it is apparently hoping such results can be replicated nationwide through the expanded deployment. “After a successful initial rollout to the National Capital Region in September, the FAA will now use SMART in the airspace of all 22 centers across the country to reduce delays, reduce fuel consumption and improve the travel experience for the flying public,” according to the agency statement posted on November 10. This trend represents a new concern for Big Tech companies—but also for governments and everyone else who depends on common digital services in modern life. To explore what this all means for modern society’s reliance on cloud resilience, I will be hosting a live conversation titled "Drone attacks and data centers: New Risks for Big Tech" on Tuesday, November 17 at 1 pm ET with Joseph Jarnecki , a senior research fellow at the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI), a UK defense and security think tank. He leads RUSI’s work on how cloud services factor into national security and defense, along with tech sovereignty efforts. Jarnecki has done extensive research on how Ukraine strengthened its cloud resilience with Western partners despite facing both cyberattacks and kinetic attacks at the start of the full-scale Russian invasion, and explored what that means for NATO and European governments’ cloud adoption plans. items.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing 3.8 Flash
items.raw_text: Google is continuing its elemental AI naming scheme with the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen . These names are less descriptive than the Pro/Flash monikers of earlier releases, but Hydrogen's purpose is clear: It replaces the faster, more economical Flash models most people in Google's ecosystem use. With Google's recent Argon and Carbon releases, the rollout was staged and began with cybersecurity researchers. Even when general availability began, Google restricted access to users paying for its most expensive AI subscription. The limits for Hydrogen are much more relaxed, with access beginning immediately. This model has replaced Gemini 3.8 Flash across the company's products. Google claims that Hydrogen represents a major improvement versus the previous Flash model. It runs in one of four thinking levels (low, medium, high, and the new xhigh), and even in high mode, it's 2.5 times faster than Flash 3.8. Plus, it reduces "fabricated claims" by more than 5x, according to Google's analysis. Users will also see gains in code generation, with Hydrogen more than tripling 3.8 Flash's score in Terminal-Bench. In some cases, Hydrogen even trades blows with Argon. It managed a score of 54 in the popular Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with xhigh mode versus 50 for Argon. Read full article Comments

"The speed limit is back at 161 kilometers per hour—that’s 100 miles per hour." Zelenskyy's allegation is that Starshield—the military variant of SpaceX's Starlink satellite service—stops working on Ukrainian military drones when they travel above 161 kilometers per hour. items.raw_text: CHICAGO—Families joined protests in seven cities nationwide on Wednesday, rallying against what they see as Google’s bid to entrench its AI models in schools, turn kids of all ages into Gemini guinea pigs, and hook them on AI. The backlash follows a Google statement last week, confirming that there will be no way for students to use Google Search without AI. While Google claimed it was giving schools “more choice, not less”—by turning off Search, Gemini, and Gemini Notebook by default—it would not provide an option that allowed Search without AI. For students, the only way to avoid interacting with AI was to remember to add “-ai” to every query, parents worried. In Chicago, many families showed up to protest Google, despite cold, rainy weather. Waving signs, dozens of protesters marched up to Google’s downtown office as workers seemed to be leaving for the day, shouting chants like “Hey Google, nice try, we don’t want your Gemini” and “Hey, Google, leave our kids alone!” Read full article Comments

items.title: Netflix releases new trailer for Ray Gunn
items.raw_text: We caught the first trailer for the upcoming Netflix animated film Ray Gunn in September and were charmed by director Brad Bird's blend of a Jetsons-like future with classic 1930s noir detective thrillers. Bird has described it as a mashup of The Maltese Falcon and Buck Rogers , and the latest trailer definitely gives off that energy. As previously reported , Bird has directed some of our all-time favorite animated films: The Iron Giant (1999), The Incredibles (2004), and Ratatouille (2007), with the latter two snagging well-deserved Oscar wins. He's been kicking around the idea for Ray Gunn for the last 30 years, working on his many other film projects while the Ray Gunn script—co-written by Matthew Robbins, who also co-wrote 1987’s Batteries Not Included with Bird—“stayed in a filing cabinet at Warner Brothers,” the director said earlier this year. The film’s inspiration came when Bird heard the opening of the B-52s’ “ Planet Claire ” (a personal favorite that also provides the soundtrack to the new trailer) and initially thought it was a cover of Henry Mancini’s theme music from the classic TV show Peter Gunn . Bird is a longtime fan of film noir and hard-boiled detectives, and he came up with the idea of a futuristic detective named Ray Gunn (a play on " raygun ," of course). “It’s film noir and a hard-boiled detective story, but it’s got a lot more comedy and a lot more action than the average film noir,” said Bird . Avellan emphasized, over and over again, that AST plans to build a "simple" rocket. He paraphrased SpaceX founder Elon Musk several times, saying, "the best part is no part." items.title: Man's secret use of synthetic testosterone for cows nearly destroyed his heart
items.raw_text: For 11 years, a Massachusetts man had an alarming array of health problems, most notably that his heart kept failing. He landed in the hospital over and over again, needed life support at one point, spent years going to specialists, and underwent a barrage of tests along the way. But through it all, he never revealed a key detail behind his ailments: He was taking powerful, illicit synthetic testosterone derivatives (aka anabolic-androgenic steroids, or AAS). One of the drugs he took was approved only for use in animals; it's primarily used to beef up cows. Left in the dark, his doctors had to puzzle this out on their own. In a case report in this week's issue of the New England Journal of Medicine, they explain how they did it. They also offer a warning: These cases will only become more common, and clinicians need to know what they look like. Read full article Comments

items.title: The amazing disappearing exoplanet
items.raw_text: One nice thing about discovering exoplanets is that, once you work out how long their orbits take, they continue to show up like clockwork. The timing is so regular, in fact, that we can use variations to detect the gravitational influence of additional planets in the same exosolar system. And the precise timing is useful in that we can rely on it to point telescopes at the system when we know some of the light we detect has passed through the planet's atmosphere. Except when we can't. On Monday, researchers reported on an exoplanet that simply stopped showing up. TOI-2535b is a hot Jupiter-sized planet we've been observing as it transits between its host star, TOI-2535, and Earth for about seven years now. But it recently stopped showing up, and researchers suspect that's due to an unseen companion orbiting in a different plane. Read full article Comments

items.title: Google pushes privacy angle as Gemini-powered smartglasses debut starting at $395
items.raw_text: Smartglasses have always faced an uphill road to acceptance. Not only is propping a computer up on your nose an uncomfortable proposition, but the privacy aspect has been vexing people since the Google Glass days . Now, Google is ready to take another swing at " intelligent eyewear " for the Gemini era after previewing its plans a couple of times. The first glasses are up for preorder today from Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, but they're no impulse buy. These devices are a collaboration between Google, Samsung, and the aforementioned eyewear designers. Gentle Monster and Warby Parker have each designed a few different frames, with options for transparent and tinted lenses. Samsung is providing the computing hardware that fits inside them, and Google has the software covered. Warby Parker has designed three frames for Google eyewear, called Alden, Reid, and Wren (see above). They are available with both standard optical and sun lenses in Pine, Saddle, and Jet Black colors at $395 and higher. Warby Parker is only selling devices in the US. Gentle Monster has gone a bit further with six styles, but Google hasn't told us any names for those yet. They come in dark red, pink, gray, and yellow colors and are available with clear, tinted, blue, or brown lenses. The Gentle Monster styles start a little higher at $449, and they will be available in the US and South Korea. Read full article Comments

Daarmee benadrukt het kabinet dat de ondersteuning van jonge kinderen en hun ouders een gezamenlijke opgave is van onderwijs, zorg, welzijn en andere maatschappelijke partners. Vanuit het SPN-project Gezinsgericht werken aan brede basisvaardigheden bekijken we de belangrijkste inzichten uit de Kamerbrief en het commissiedebat over het jonge kind. Wat betekenen deze ontwikkelingen voor de rol van bibliotheken en welke kansen bieden ze om gezinnen, in samenwerking met lokale partners, beter te ondersteunen? Het bedrijf sluit een cyberaanval uit, maar heeft nog niet bekendgemaakt waardoor de servers onbeschikbaar werden. In de eerste uren van deze ochtend meldde het bedrijf weliswaar vooruitgang, maar ook rond 08.45 uur was nog geen sprake van stabiele dienstverlening. items.title: Whoop launched a social network where every user has a ‘verified heartbeat’
items.raw_text: Starting Thursday, Whoop members can share their data from its wearables on the app's new Whoop Humans social network. Users can make their metrics, activities, and achievements visible to other Whoop wearers, post Story-like "Moments" with photos and captions, and add comments and reactions on other members' posts. Whoop claims its platform is "entirely human," unlike other social media platforms that are "saturated with artificial intelligence, automated accounts and bots, and manufactured content." Whoop CEO Will Ahmed says Humans is "the most verifiably human network ever launched. Every account represents a real person with a verified … Read the full story at The Verge.

items.title: Humble Bundle redesign removes two-factor verification from settings
items.raw_text: The Humble Bundle storefront for buying games and other software recently got a new look, but on the settings page, it no longer offers a way to add or update two-factor verification methods, as reported by Kotaku . PC Gamer also points out that there are Humble Bundle support pages discussing two-factor verification , and the writer for the publication said that they had set up two-factor verification on the old version of the site. However, it does appear that, at least as of now, there is some form of two-factor verification. items.raw_text: Microsoft Outlook continues to be unavailable for people, businesses, and public services across the globe, leaving people unable to access their email, either through the web or apps. items.title: Xbox owners are getting more customizations for backgrounds and the Guide menu
items.raw_text: Microsoft is starting to test new customization options for Xbox consoles today. Xbox Insiders will be able to start testing new rotating backgrounds, new library options for digital games, and the ability to move the Xbox Guide menu to the right-hand side. "Xbox Insiders can now save favorite dynamic backgrounds and shuffle through them automatically," says Eden Marie , principal software engineering lead at Xbox. "You can also choose Shuffle at the start of any background category. Have your background change each time you sign in, or set it to change hourly, daily, or weekly." items.title: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
items.raw_text: Google says its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model can give more helpful answers to complex questions, including "questions with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests." The new model can break down your questions and address each part in its responses. It's available starting today in search, the Gemini app, all tiers of Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, and in Google Antigravity for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. Robby Stein, VP of product at Google Search, says it's "now the new default model in AI Mode & being used for your hardest questions in AI Overviews." items.raw_text: Nvidia announced this morning that Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO following reports of two affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy and one with a direct report. items.title: The Oura Ring 4 is almost as good as the newer model, but $150 cheaper
items.raw_text: The previous-generation Oura Ring 4 is on sale for as low as $249 at Amazon , Best Buy , and Target , $100 off the retail price, and the first big discount on the device since July. The price varies a bit by size and color, with most silver and black models in stock at the lowest price between sizes 8 and 13. Best Buy also has an exclusive deep blue “midnight” color in stock for $279. If you’re not sure about your size, you can pick up an Oura Ring 4 sizing kit for $10 at Amazon or Target , which includes $10 in store credit towards an Oura Ring 4 purchase. Oura Ring 4 The last-gen Oura Ring 4 is a little thicker, but offers much of the same software, sensors, and a wider range of sizes. Where to Buy: $349 $249 at Amazon $349 $249 at Best Buy My colleague Victoria Song tested six different smart rings to compare their health and fitness tracking features, and Oura beat them all handily. The Oura Ring 4 improved on its predecessor with more accurate sensors, a slimmer design that leaves the competition in the dust, not to mention frequent software and feature updates. Accessing all of the features requires an active subscription , which is either $5.99 per month or $69.99 per year. The newer Oura Ring 5 is lighter and thinner, but otherwise includes the same sensors and software features as the Oura Ring 4. items.title: Nvidia-topman struikelt over tweede liefdesafaire
items.raw_text: Nvidia-topman Jensen Huang, drijvende kracht achter de ai-hausse, stapt met onmiddellijke ingang op bij zijn bedrijf na twee buitenechtelijke affaires. Zijn positie was onhoudbaar geworden, nadat uitlekte dat hij niet alleen vreemdging met een vermeende Chinese spionne maar ook een relatie had met een personeelslid. De 63-jarige Nvidia-baas blijkt ook een liefdesnestje te hebben gehad met Kimberly Powell, de manager die verantwoordelijk is voor de activiteiten van Nvidia op gebied van de gezondheidszorg. De New York Times berichtte als eerste over deze tweede affaire. Sterk is de indruk dat Nvidia’s Raad van Commissarissen Jensen Huang heeft gevraagd de eer aan zichzelf te houden en zijn ontslag aan te bieden. Nvidia bevestigt het vertrek van zijn charismatische leider in een persbericht. CFO Colette Kress is benoemd tot interim CEO. De Board van Nvidia is begonnen een opvolger voor Jensen Huang te vinden, een van de machtigste it-ondernemers ter wereld. De mede-oprichter van Nvidia had bij zijn bedrijf alle touwtjes in handen. Alle belangrijke beslissingen liepen via hem. Hij had zelf eerder verklaard dat het niet nodig was een opvolger voor hem klaar te stomen. Het wordt daarom een zware klus een geschikte opvolger te vinden. Jensen Huang was ook het gezicht van Nvidia. Hij had de status van een ‘rock star’. Hij maakte veel indruk, ook op vrouwen. items.title: Pilot Werkplaats Ontwerpende Aanpak gestart bij Bibliotheek De Lage Beemden
items.raw_text: Hoe kan de ontwerpende aanpak een vaste plek krijgen binnen bibliotheken? Dat is de centrale vraag binnen de Werkplaats Ontwerpende Aanpak. Bij Bibliotheek De Lage Beemden is hiervoor een pilot gestart. SPN heeft social designer Charlotte Grün betrokken om samen met medewerkers en directie met de ontwerpende aanpak aan de slag te gaan. SPN volgt het traject om te onderzoeken wat dit vraagt van de bibliotheekorganisatie. De Werkplaats wordt vanuit SPN begeleid door projectleider Caroline Koevoets en adviseur Bastiaan van den Berg. Documentairemaker Jens Vervoort volgt de pilot en legt de ervaringen vast. Voortbouwen op eerdere ervaringen De afgelopen jaren hebben verschillende bibliotheken ervaring opgedaan met social design. Binnen Social Design in de bieb onderzochten Probiblio en BiSC met zeven bibliotheken wat de inzet van een social designer voor een bibliotheekteam kan betekenen. Met de Werkplaats Ontwerpende Aanpak bouwt SPN voort op deze ervaringen. Dit keer staat de bibliotheek als organisatie centraal. SPN onderzoekt wat medewerkers en directie nodig hebben om ook na afloop van een ontwerptraject met de opgedane inzichten en werkwijzen verder te kunnen. Ook wordt gekeken welke rol POI’s hierin kunnen spelen. Pilot bij Bibliotheek De Lage Beemden De pilot bij Bibliotheek de Lage Beemden begint bij digitaal burgerschap.
